nodes.title: SG-4.3 Confirm Phaser 3.90 game config pixel-art, DPR and fit scaling
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts builds the Phaser config (pixelArt, roundPixels, antialias false, Scale.FIT, CENTER_BOTH) and exports computeZoom(w,h,dpr), which nothing consumes yet. Desired behavior: config uses only 3.90-valid keys, DPR handling is safe, and unit tests run with phaser mocked. Why: crisp pixel art at any device pixel ratio.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given buildGameConfig is called, When inspected, Then render.pixelArt, render.roundPixels are true and antialias is false
- Given buildGameConfig is called, When inspected, Then scale.mode is Scale.FIT with autoCenter CENTER_BOTH and autoRound true
- Given computeZoom receives a zero, negative or NaN dpr, When called, Then it returns an integer >= 1
- Given phaser is mocked, When the config unit tests run, Then they pass


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/tests/phaserConfig.test.ts
- Out of scope: Scenes, assets, React host changes
- Preserve: GAME_WIDTH/GAME_HEIGHT 640x360
- Preserve: createGame seam
- Preserve: phaser ~3.90.0 pin


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 only; no Phaser 4 keys


## Definition of done
- All requirements have passing unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Device-pixel-ratio zoom helper is safe for invalid ratios
nodes.body:
Context: computeZoom(w,h,dpr) floors min((w*dpr)/640,(h*dpr)/360). A dpr of 0, negative or NaN yields 0/NaN-driven results. Desired: invalid dpr is treated as 1. Expected: integer >= 1 always.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given dpr is NaN, 0 or negative, When computeZoom(1280,720,dpr) runs, Then it returns 2
- Given dpr 2 and a 1000x600 viewport, When computeZoom runs, Then it returns an integer >= 1


## Scope
- In scope: computeZoom in config.ts
- Out of scope: Wiring zoom into PhaserHost
- Preserve: Signature (w,h,dpr)
- Preserve: Valid-input results


## Definition of done
- Invalid dpr normalised


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.summary: computeZoom treats non-finite or non-positive dpr as 1
nodes.description: Guard dpr at the top of computeZoom in config.ts.

steps.action: Add const ratio = Number.isFinite(dpr) && dpr > 0 ? dpr : 1 and use ratio instead of dpr in the formula.
steps.code:
const ratio = Number.isFinite(dpr) && dpr > 0 ? dpr : 1;
return Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.min((w * ratio) / GAME_WIDTH, (h * ratio) / GAME_HEIGHT)));
